detailed_descriptions.en: The Bhashiva Character Pack introduces Bhashiva, The White Tiger, as a new playable Legendary Lord alongside a deadly company of mercenary Tiger Warrior units for the armies of Grand Cathay. With the purchase of this Character Pack, players will also gain access to the core Grand Cathay roster if they do not already own any other associated Grand Cathay content. Campaign Feature – Armies of Shang-Yang Bhashiva calls upon the armies of Shang-Yang to bolster her military might. Complete missions for Zhao Ming to earn Iron Favour, to expand army and unit capacity, or assign Insignias to Cathayan units. Specialising individual units through training and insights from across Grand Cathay to create a battle-hardened force. Campaign Feature – The Tiger Court Matters of great importance to the Tiger Warriors and Bhashiva, occur within the Tiger Court. Here the White Tiger will pass judgment and rule to one of three strategic Pillars. Capture settlements of importance and complete Ivory Road journeys to earn Relics, enact sweeping Oaths, and shape your faction’s identity and longterm strategy as your influence grows. Battle Playstyle Bhashiva and the Tiger Warriors fight as an aggressive pack, built around speed, agility, and stealth. They reward players who think like predators; stalking the battlefield before striking targets with precise violence. New Units: - Legendary Lord: Bhashiva the Desert Tigress, The White Tiger of Shang-Yang - Lord: Tiger Warrior Sawai - Hero: Clawspeaker (Beasts, Life, & Shadows) - Unit: Tiger Warrior (Dual Axes) - Unit: Tiger Warrior Stalkers (Throwing Discs) - Unit: Iron Claw Tiger Warriors (Guandao)

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Bhashiva Character Pack introduces Bhashiva, The White Tiger, as a new playable Legendary Lord alongside a deadly company of mercenary Tiger Warrior units for the armies of Grand Cathay. 

With the purchase of this Character Pack, players will also gain access to the core Grand Cathay roster if they do not already own any other associated Grand Cathay content.

Campaign Feature – Armies of Shang-Yang

Bhashiva calls upon the armies of Shang-Yang to bolster her military might. Complete missions for Zhao Ming to earn Iron Favour, to expand army and unit capacity, or assign Insignias to Cathayan units. Specialising individual units through training and insights from across Grand Cathay to create a battle-hardened force.

Campaign Feature – The Tiger Court

Matters of great importance to the Tiger Warriors and Bhashiva, occur within the Tiger Court. Here the White Tiger will pass judgment and rule to one of three strategic Pillars. Capture settlements of importance and complete Ivory Road journeys to earn Relics, enact sweeping Oaths, and shape your faction’s identity and longterm strategy as your influence grows.

Battle Playstyle

Bhashiva and the Tiger Warriors fight as an aggressive pack, built around speed, agility, and stealth. They reward players who think like predators; stalking the battlefield before striking targets with precise violence.

New Units: 

- Legendary Lord: Bhashiva the Desert Tigress, The White Tiger of Shang-Yang 

- Lord: Tiger Warrior Sawai 

- Hero: Clawspeaker (Beasts, Life, & Shadows)

- Unit: Tiger Warrior (Dual Axes) 

- Unit: Tiger Warrior Stalkers (Throwing Discs) 

- Unit: Iron Claw Tiger Warriors (Guandao)
